scope: New measured2x2 anchors tested on other geometry; gates fixed before target measurements. Private original pixel checks and public numeric replay are separate.

protocol.question: Do new2x2 measured anchors transfer to2x4 bricks of the same verified materials?
protocol.sample: All unique native98x73image objects across the same34modern source books. Select every opaque unprinted standard2x4 full-height brick of the three verified new materials, before measuring target face RGB.
protocol.identity: Exact element label and official LEGO color mapping; do not infer solely from pixel similarity. Keep unmatched candidates as unresolved.
protocol.methods: Compare fixed2x2 anchors and nominal current renderer fallback, plus frozen face-law transfer using measured target left. No refit on2x4; report all selected sources and nine window shifts.
protocol.tolerance: Per material overall three-faceMAE<=3 and max_channel<=10; all9same-shift repeats must meet this for promotion of that new material. A rendering engineering gate, not a significance test.
protocol.deduplication: Same source image reused is not a new independent control. Report per material and all raw images; avoid pooled frequency weighting as primary conclusion.

selection.exclusion_rule: All other shapes/colors visually unlike the three new materials; two darker blue/green candidates retained for ID resolution before exclusion. No face RGB or residual measured.
